_comment: Platform-agnostic source of truth for scheduled/automation tasks. Each task has a prompt.md (plain instructions, no platform-specific frontmatter). scripts/sync-tasks.js renders these into whatever platform you target (Cowork by default; Codex, Antigravity, etc. via --platform). Edit prompt.md + this manifest here, then sync.

tasks.description: Invoke the watchlist-sync skill (default Near Highs sync from Chartist Near High Scan)
Invoke the watchlist-insights skill (default 24h digest across Near Highs + Radar)
Invoke the insight-validation skill (default: validate latest notes, ledger + proposals, email)
Invoke the gainers-signal skill (default top-50 gainers → conviction signals email)
Upload Stock Reports To Google Drive
Weekday-morning delta scan: apply new announcements/results to every stored Investment Thesis and flag signal changes.
Saturday deep review of all Investment Theses: staleness, valuation re-anchor, monitorables, and portfolio-level signal summary.
Email top 10 NSE/BSE bulk, block, SAST and insider trades by value, daily at 7:30 PM IST (Mon–Fri)
